title: Zesty Peruvian Beef Stew
description: A hearty and energizing Peruvian dish featuring ground allspice and cured beef, made in a mason jar and Whole30-friendly. This herbal and pillowy stew is perfect for a cold evening.
instructions: Brown the ground beef in a pan over medium-high heat, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
Add the ground allspice and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the cured beef, onion, and garlic to the pan and cook until the onion is translucent.
Add the beef broth, potatoes, and carrots to the pan and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 30 minutes, or until the potatoes and carrots are tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Ladle the stew into a mason jar and serve hot.
Garnish with fresh herbs, if desired.
